name: Bastia Leoner
source:
Being a Leoner, Bastia's a vampire hunter and common enemy in the Circle. Standing nearly as tall as Emma and slightly thicker, she wears black sexy armor that reveals her lower back, waist, cleavage, and half of both butt cheeks; a mid-back-length veil down the back of her head; and a black angular mask around the eyes.

Bastia and her sister [spoiler]watched MC for years and knew he was going to rebel against the Circle before he even learned of its existence[/spoiler], but are surprised to see that he recruited vampires (in the vampire route).

Surprisingly, she explicitly [spoiler]shows a flirtatious attraction to Emma, to the latter's disgust, after offering a temporary alliance "until we finish off the Circle" and receiving a vague threat.[/spoiler]

[b]Vampire Type[/b]: n/a
